name: Blocks Scanner – Find and Manage Blocks Across Your Site
author: dmrhn

sections.description:
Blocks Scanner lists every block used across your content, grouped by post, by block type, or as a sortable flat table. Filters update to show only what matches your current selection. Open any post from its title, or view it from the arrow beside the title.

Features

  • Views: By post (default), By block, Flat.
  • Light, dark or system theme, saved per user, with a theme toggle in the header.
  • Primary color for the whole scanner, chosen with the WordPress color picker.
  • Choose which post types to scan, including patterns.
  • Settings open in a panel from the gear icon.
  • Jump straight to the editor or the public page of any post that uses a block.

Usage

  • Once activated, navigate to Tools > Blocks Scanner in your WordPress admin panel.
  • The plugin will automatically scan all posts, pages, and custom post types and patterns.
  • You can then view the list of posts that utilize blocks on your site and take appropriate actions quickly.

Support

For support, bug reports, or feature requests, please visit the GitHub repository and create an issue.
sections.faq:
How do I scan Gutenberg blocks on my site?

After activating the Blocks Scanner plugin, navigate to Tools > Blocks Scanner in your WordPress admin panel. The plugin will automatically scan all posts, pages, and custom post types to list the Gutenberg blocks used on your site.

Can I edit or view posts containing specific blocks?

Yes, Blocks Scanner allows you to quickly edit or view the posts that contain specific blocks. Once you’ve scanned your site, you can easily identify and manage blocks from the plugin’s interface.

What if I encounter any issues or have feature requests?

If you encounter any issues, have feature requests, or need support, please visit the GitHub repository and create an issue. Our team will be happy to assist you.

What about compatibility with other plugins/themes?

Blocks Scanner is designed to work smoothly with most WordPress themes and plugins. However, if you experience any compatibility issues, please let us know by creating an issue on the GitHub repository.

How often does Blocks Scanner update its block list?

Blocks Scanner scans your content every time you open Tools > Blocks Scanner, so the list always reflects the current state of your site.

Is Blocks Scanner compatible with multisite installations?

Yes. You can activate the plugin network-wide, and each site in the network shows the blocks used on that site. It does not combine results across sites.
